import random
import sys
from urllib.parse import urljoin as ref_urljoin

# Import the function under test
# Since we can't redefine it, we assume it's available in the namespace
# But the task says "Do not redefine the function", so we need to have it defined.
# The previous code block defined urljoin_. We'll assume it's in the global scope.
# If not, we'd need to import it, but the task implies it's already defined.
# Let's just reference it directly.

def run_tests():
    mismatches = []
    total = 0

    def check(base, url):
        nonlocal total
        total += 1
        try:
            my_result = urljoin_(base, url)
            my_exc = None
        except Exception as e:
            my_result = None
            my_exc = type(e)

        try:
            ref_result = ref_urljoin(base, url)
            ref_exc = None
        except Exception as e:
            ref_result = None
            ref_exc = type(e)

        # Compare
        if my_exc is not None or ref_exc is not None:
            if my_exc is not None and ref_exc is not None:
                if my_exc != ref_exc:
                    mismatches.append((base, url, my_result, ref_result))
            else:
                mismatches.append((base, url, my_result, ref_result))
        else:
            if my_result != ref_result:
                mismatches.append((base, url, my_result, ref_result))

    # Edge cases from the task
    edge_cases = [
        # Absolute URLs replace the base
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "http://other.com/new/path"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "https://other.com/new/path"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "ftp://other.com/new/path"),
        
        # Scheme-relative //host/p
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "//other.com/new/path"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "//other.com"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "//other.com/"),
        
        # Absolute paths /p
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "/new/path"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "/"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "/new"),
        
        # Relative paths
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "relative/path"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "relative"),
        ("http://example.com/base/", "relative/path"),
        ("http://example.com/base/", "relative"),
        ("http://example.com", "relative/path"),
        ("http://example.com", "relative"),
        
        # . and .. normalization
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "./relative"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "../relative"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "../../relative"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "./../relative"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", ".."),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "."),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", "../.."),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", "../../.."),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", "../../../.."),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", "./././relative"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", ".././relative"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", "./../relative"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", "..//relative"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", "../..//relative"),
        
        # Empty string returning the base without its fragment
        ("http://example.com/base/path", ""),
        ("http://example.com/base/path#frag", ""),
        ("http://example.com/base/path?query", ""),
        ("http://example.com/base/path?query#frag", ""),
        ("http://example.com", ""),
        ("http://example.com/", ""),
        ("http://example.com/base", ""),
        
        # Query-only ?q
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "?newquery"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path?oldquery", "?newquery"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path#frag", "?newquery"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path?oldquery#frag", "?newquery"),
        ("http://example.com", "?newquery"),
        ("http://example.com/", "?newquery"),
        
        # Fragment-only #f
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "#newfrag"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path#oldfrag", "#newfrag"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path?query", "#newfrag"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path?query#oldfrag", "#newfrag"),
        ("http://example.com", "#newfrag"),
        ("http://example.com/", "#newfrag"),
        
        # More complex combinations
        ("http://example.com/base/path?query#frag", "new/path?newquery#newfrag"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path?query#frag", "/new/path?newquery#newfrag"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path?query#frag", "//other.com/new/path?newquery#newfrag"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path?query#frag", "http://other.com/new/path?newquery#newfrag"),
        
        # Edge cases with empty components
        ("", "http://example.com/path"),
        ("", "//example.com/path"),
        ("", "/path"),
        ("", "path"),
        ("", "?query"),
        ("", "#frag"),
        ("", ""),
        
        ("http://example.com", ""),
        ("http://example.com", "/"),
        ("http://example.com", "//"),
        ("http://example.com", "//other.com"),
        ("http://example.com", "//other.com/"),
        ("http://example.com", "//other.com/path"),
        
        # Paths with multiple slashes
        ("http://example.com/base//path", "relative"),
        ("http://example.com/base//path", "/relative"),
        ("http://example.com/base//path", "../relative"),
        ("http://example.com/base//path", "./relative"),
        
        # Query and fragment with special characters
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "?a=b&c=d"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "#a=b&c=d"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "relative?a=b&c=d#frag"),
        ("http://example.com/base/path", "/relative?a=b&c=d#frag"),
        
        # More .. edge cases
        ("http://example.com/a", "../b"),
        ("http://example.com/a", "../../b"),
        ("http://example.com/a", "../../../b"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b", "../c"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b", "../../c"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b", "../../../c"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", "../d"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", "../../d"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", "../../../d"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", "../../../../d"),
        
        # Trailing slashes
        ("http://example.com/base/", "path"),
        ("http://example.com/base/", "/path"),
        ("http://example.com/base/", "../path"),
        ("http://example.com/base/", "./path"),
        ("http://example.com/base/", ""),
        ("http://example.com/base/", "?query"),
        ("http://example.com/base/", "#frag"),
        
        # No trailing slash
        ("http://example.com/base", "path"),
        ("http://example.com/base", "/path"),
        ("http://example.com/base", "../path"),
        ("http://example.com/base", "./path"),
        ("http://example.com/base", ""),
        ("http://example.com/base", "?query"),
        ("http://example.com/base", "#frag"),
        
        # Root path
        ("http://example.com/", "path"),
        ("http://example.com/", "/path"),
        ("http://example.com/", "../path"),
        ("http://example.com/", "./path"),
        ("http://example.com/", ""),
        ("http://example.com/", "?query"),
        ("http://example.com/", "#frag"),
        
        # Just host
        ("http://example.com", "path"),
        ("http://example.com", "/path"),
        ("http://example.com", "../path"),
        ("http://example.com", "./path"),
        ("http://example.com", ""),
        ("http://example.com", "?query"),
        ("http://example.com", "#frag"),
    ]

    for base, url in edge_cases:
        check(base, url)

    # Generate 300 random inputs
    rng = random.Random(0)
    
    schemes = ["http", "https", "ftp", "mailto", ""]
    hosts = ["example.com", "other.com", "sub.example.com", "localhost", "192.168.1.1", ""]
    paths = [
        "", "/", "/path", "/path/to/resource", "/a/b/c", "/a/b/c/d",
        "relative", "relative/path", "a/b/c", "../up", "./here",
        "/absolute", "//host/path", "query?param=value", "frag#section",
        "path?query#frag", "/path?query#frag",
    ]
    queries = ["", "q=1", "a=b&c=d", "x=1&y=2&z=3"]
    fragments = ["", "frag", "section", "top"]

    for _ in range(300):
        # Generate random base
        base_scheme = rng.choice(schemes)
        base_host = rng.choice(hosts)
        base_path = rng.choice(paths)
        base_query = rng.choice(queries)
        base_fragment = rng.choice(fragments)
        
        base = ""
        if base_scheme:
            base += base_scheme + ":"
        if base_host:
            base += "//" + base_host
        base += base_path
        if base_query:
            base += "?" + base_query
        if base_fragment:
            base += "#" + base_fragment

        # Generate random url
        url_scheme = rng.choice(schemes)
        url_host = rng.choice(hosts)
        url_path = rng.choice(paths)
        url_query = rng.choice(queries)
        url_fragment = rng.choice(fragments)
        
        url = ""
        if url_scheme:
            url += url_scheme + ":"
        if url_host:
            url += "//" + url_host
        url += url_path
        if url_query:
            url += "?" + url_query
        if url_fragment:
            url += "#" + url_fragment

        check(base, url)

    # Print first 5 mismatches
    for i, (base, url, my_out, ref_out) in enumerate(mismatches[:5]):
        print(f"Mismatch {i+1}:")
        print(f"  base: {base!r}")
        print(f"  url:  {url!r}")
        print(f"  my:   {my_out!r}")
        print(f"  ref:  {ref_out!r}")

    n = len(mismatches)
    print(f"MISMATCHES {n} OF {total}")
    
    if n > 0:
        sys.exit(1)
    else:
        sys.exit(0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_tests()
